limitations: Pathname identity/revalidation is not atomic ancestor containment; nested mounts and same-device bind mounts remain P0.
Saved plans have no root/leaf identity snapshot from original scan; current pins begin during apply.
Windows cross-compilation does not qualify NTFS/ReFS/SMB runtime, junctions, installed packages or consoles; macOS/ARM64 hosted evidence remains open.
Failed recursive deletion can have removed descendants; unattempted nested entries are not proof their contents survived.
Filesystem calls may block despite cooperative cancellation; SIGKILL/power loss cannot flush outcomes.
Logical resource bounds and sampled fixture RSS do not prove OOM immunity or leak absence.
Warm local empirical percentiles do not qualify cold/network storage, allocated 200 GiB deletion or physical reclamation.
History is best-effort, not a crash-durable recovery journal; trash is not a complete restore/purge product.
Dependency advisory/license provenance and hosted release qualification remain open.
Host parse/planning/terminal input latency and real docs browser/mobile qualification remain open.
logsNote: Ephemeral /tmp logs supplement durable benchmark JSON and regression tests. They are not hosted CI evidence.
